summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the new Workshops feature (Paws Cat Café Stripe booking flow) plus regression on existing checkout/login endpoints. All 10 backend pytest tests passed. Frontend renders 3 workshop cards with correct copy, images, time chips and CTAs; Paws Cat Café dialog submits to /api/workshops/checkout and redirects to Stripe Checkout with proper £45 product line item. MongoDB persistence verified: workshop_bookings doc created with status='pending' and payment_transactions row with full metadata (workshop_id, workshop_name, workshop_location, workshop_date, workshop_time, full_name, customer_email, notes, amount_paid, booking_id, type).

issues: Workshop images are placeholder Google Drive links and currently return broken images (404). Per E1 note this is EXPECTED until real images are supplied.

action_items: Provide real workshop image URLs (currently using Google Drive placeholders that 404).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1371 lines — consider splitting into routers (orders, workshops, auth, contact, webhook) for maintainability.
workshop list is hardcoded in WorkshopsPage.jsx; future workshops require a code deploy. Consider moving to backend collection + admin UI.
send_workshop_booking_emails is sync inside async — _send_email uses requests/resend SDK synchronously; ok because invoked via background_tasks but worth noting for high volume.
Frontend dialog form relies on HTML5 required for empty-field validation; the explicit setError path (data-testid=workshop-booking-error) is only reachable if browser HTML5 validation is bypassed.
seed_data_creation: Tests created TEST_* prefixed bookings + payment_transactions; all cleaned up after run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Workshops feature backend route: POST /api/workshops/checkout (validations on full_name/email/price>0, creates Stripe session w/ metadata, inserts workshop_bookings + payment_transactions). GET /api/orders/status/{session_id} now also handles workshop bookings (sets status='paid', triggers send_workshop_booking_emails to both customer + events@petalandpaw.co.uk). Frontend page /workshops has 3 cards w/ data-testid=workshop-{id} and book-workshop-{id}; only paws-cat-cafe-2026-06-26 uses Stripe dialog. Stripe redirect verified end-to-end (cs_test_* session created).
